## 0. Type errors first

   `shared/i18n/ar-finance.ts` / `en-finance.ts` (the `ar-medical.ts` pattern) and register them.
2. **Module maps:** add `finance: false` to every module map (mock seed, fixtures, tests, the platform
   module switches and defaults). Platform label: «المالية» / "Finance". It needs «المراجعون» / Patients:
   use the existing dependency rule (`moduleDependencyGap`).
3. **Role editor:** `permission-matrix.tsx` gains the group «المالية» / "Finance" with rows

## 1. Settings → Services: prices

- A price column (formatted in the clinic currency; «بدون سعر» / "No price" when null).
- «تعديل السعر» / "Edit price": `PATCH /v1/services/:id/price` `{priceMinor | null}`; the input is in major
  units, converted with `parseMajorToMinor` (a KWD price has 3 decimals, SAR 2).
- «أسعار الدكاترة» / "Doctor prices" dialog: the whole list per service, `PUT /v1/services/:id/provider-prices`.
- Read prices from `GET /v1/prices` only; `GET /v1/services` never carries a price.
- Visible with `view:prices:clinic`; editing needs `update:prices:clinic`. Hidden entirely when finance is off.

## 2. Settings → Clinic: finance details

- `GET /v1/clinic/settings/finance` (`financeSettingsSchema`) gives the clinic currency, its exponent and
  the tax rate: show them read-only (the platform sets them) and use them for every amount on every finance
  screen. Never hardcode KWD or 3 decimals.

- Commercial registration number: `PATCH /v1/clinic/settings/finance` `{commercialRegNo}` (≤ 40).
- Logo: `PUT /v1/clinic/logo` (PNG or JPEG ≤ 1 MB), shown from `GET /v1/clinic/logo`. Needs
  `update:clinic_settings:clinic`.

## 3. «فاتورة» / "Invoice" on appointment and visit pages

- With `create:invoices:*`: `GET /v1/invoices/draft?source=appointment|visit&id=…` pre-fills the form.
- Find an existing invoice with `GET /v1/invoices?source=…&sourceId=…&status=issued`; when one exists, show
  «عرض الفاتورة» / "View invoice" instead.

## 4. Invoice form (create and edit)

- Lines: service lines (service + doctor; price from the draft, editable) or free lines (ar + en
  description). Quantity 1–999, 1–50 lines. Live totals from `computeInvoiceTotals`; the tax line shows
  only when the rate is above 0.
- Discounts on a line or on the whole invoice, % or amount, each with a required reason. The discount
  controls are visible only with `create:discounts:*`. Without it, an edit that keeps the discounts as they
  are still saves.
- Create: `POST /v1/invoices` with `Idempotency-Key`. Manual invoices pick the patient and branch; an
  appointment or visit invoice sends only `source` + `sourceId`.
- Edit: `PATCH /v1/invoices/:id` with `If-Match: <version>`. On 412 `version_conflict` show the message and
  a «إعادة التحميل» / "Reload" button; never overwrite silently.

## 5. «الفواتير» / "Invoices" list (new nav item, needs `view:invoices:*`)

- Cursor list `GET /v1/invoices` with filters: branch, patient, status, from/to dates (clinic timezone),
  number. Status chips «صادرة» / "Issued" and «ملغاة» / "Void". Totals in the clinic currency.
- A doctor with `view:invoices:own` sees only invoices of their own patients (the API decides; the mock
  copies the patients `own` reach).

## 6. Invoice page

- Header: number, date, branch, patient; lines, discounts with reasons, tax line when > 0, total.
- A banner on a void invoice: «فاتورة ملغاة» / "Void invoice", with the reason and date.
- «PDF / طباعة» / "PDF / Print": fetches `GET /v1/invoices/:id/pdf` through the `ApiClient` as a `Blob`
  (`application/pdf`) and opens it in a new tab; printing is the browser printing that PDF. There is **no**
  web print view. The mock returns a small placeholder PDF `Blob` (as `attachmentBytes` does).
- «إلغاء الفاتورة» / "Void" (`deactivate:invoices:*`): reason required, `POST /v1/invoices/:id/void` with
  `If-Match`.
- «إرسال» / "Send" by email or WhatsApp: `POST /v1/invoices/:id/send` `{channel, sendRequestId}`. Make a new
  `sendRequestId` (UUID) for each press; a retry of the same press reuses it.

## 7. Error messages (show inline, ar + en)

| Code                       | Arabic                                                      | English                                                           |
| -------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `price_missing`            | لا يوجد سعر لهذه الخدمة؛ أضف السعر من إعدادات الخدمات أولًا | This service has no price; set it in the services settings first  |
| `invoice_prefix_missing`   | حدد بادئة الفواتير لهذا الفرع قبل إصدار أول فاتورة          | Set this branch's invoice prefix before issuing its first invoice |
| `invoice_prefix_locked`    | لا يمكن تغيير بادئة الفواتير بعد إصدار أول فاتورة في الفرع  | The invoice prefix cannot change after the branch's first invoice |
| `invoice_prefix_taken`     | هذه البادئة مستخدمة لفرع آخر في العيادة                     | Another branch of the clinic uses or used this prefix             |
| `invoice_already_exists`   | يوجد بالفعل فاتورة لهذا الموعد أو لهذه الزيارة              | An invoice already exists for this appointment or visit           |
| `invoice_void`             | هذه الفاتورة ملغاة ولا يمكن تعديلها                         | This invoice is void and cannot be changed                        |
| `currency_locked`          | لا يمكن تغيير العملة بعد تسعير خدمة أو إصدار فاتورة         | The currency cannot change once a price or an invoice exists      |
| `currency_unsupported`     | هذه العملة غير مدعومة                                       | This currency is not supported                                    |
| `discount_exceeds_total`   | الخصم أكبر من قيمة الفاتورة                                 | The discount is larger than the invoice amount                    |
| `discount_reason_required` | اكتب سبب الخصم                                              | Write the reason for the discount                                 |
| `precondition_required`    | أعد تحميل الفاتورة ثم أعد المحاولة                          | Reload the invoice, then try again                                |
| `version_conflict`         | عدّل شخص آخر هذه الفاتورة للتو؛ أعد تحميلها ثم أعد المحاولة | Someone else just changed this invoice; reload it and try again   |
| `send_request_conflict`    | طلب الإرسال هذا مستخدم لفاتورة أو قناة أخرى                 | This send request was already used for another invoice or channel |

## 8. The mock (mirrors the API)

- Prices per service and per doctor; a doctor price wins over the base price.
- Seed an `invoicePrefix` on every seeded branch (this brief has no prefix form yet), so the mock can issue.
- Numbering `PREFIX-YYYY-NNNNNN` per branch and per clinic-timezone year, gap-free; a branch without a prefix
  refuses with `invoice_prefix_missing`.
- One non-void invoice per appointment or visit (`invoice_already_exists`).
- Discount changes need `create:discounts:*` (compare old and new); totals through `computeInvoiceTotals`
  (its `TotalsError` codes map to `discount_exceeds_total` / `validation`).
- `version` starts at 1 and increments on every edit and on void; a missing `If-Match` ⇒
  `precondition_required`, a stale one ⇒ `version_conflict`; a void invoice refuses edits (`invoice_void`).
- Send: the same `sendRequestId` with the same invoice and channel returns the first result; with another
  invoice or channel ⇒ `send_request_conflict`.
- Module `finance` off ⇒ `module_disabled` on every finance call.

Tests (vitest, against the mock): each rule above, plus a table shared with the contracts' totals examples
E1–E6 to show the mock and the API compute the same totals.
